description.en: Nigeria, officially the Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a highly dynamic sovereign nation located in West Africa, bordered by Benin to the west, Cameroon to the east, Niger to the north, and the Gulf of Guinea to the south. Renowned as the most populous country in Africa and one of the continent's absolute economic powerhouses, Nigeria is globally famous for its massive oil reserves, giant consumer market, and far-reaching global cultural influence.
description.zh: Nigeria（奈及利亞，全稱為奈及利亞聯邦共和國）是位於西非最具活力的主權國家。其西鄰貝南（Benin），東接喀麥隆（Cameroon），北與尼日（Niger）接壤，南臨幾內亞灣。奈及利亞不僅是非洲人口最多的國家，也是非洲大陸絕對的經濟火車頭之一，以其極其豐富的石油儲量、龐大的內需消費市場以及深遠的全球文化影響力聞名於世。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Nigeria — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Discover Abuja capital planning, Lagos commercial hubs, Nollywood movies, Afrobeats music, Zuma Rock, and Niger River delta crude oil.
seoText.zh: 快速了解奈及利亞的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索阿布加行政都市規劃、拉哥斯商業金融核心、諾萊塢電影、Afrobeats 流行音樂、巨石地標 Zuma Rock，以及尼日河三角洲石油儲藏。

list: Sovereign West African federal republic bordering the Gulf of Guinea
The most populous nation in Africa and largest black population globally
Abundant natural resources led by petroleum and natural gas reserves
Highly vibrant multi-ethnic federation with vast cultural output
en.text:
Framed by the majestic Zuma Rock and stretching from southern mangroves to northern dry grasslands, Nigeria represents the absolute giant of West Africa. Boasting a rapidly expanding population exceeding 220 million, the country is officially home to over 250 distinct ethnic groups and 500 indigenous languages, creating a fascinating tapestry of cultural fusion.

From the high-octane startup hubs of Lagos to the massive global output of its 'Nollywood' movie industry and Afrobeats music, Nigeria serves as the primary modern pop culture exporter for the entire African continent.

list: 非洲人口最多的國家
西非最大經濟體之一
石油與天然氣資源豐富
多民族、多語言聯邦國家
zh.text: 從傲然聳立的巨石地標蘇瑪岩（Zuma Rock），到南部茂密的紅樹林濕地以及北部乾燥的撒哈拉薩赫勒草原，奈及利亞（Nigeria）是當之無愧的西非巨擘。這座擁有超過 2.2 億龐大且快速增長人口的聯邦，境內匯聚了超過 250 個各具特色的民族與 500 多種本土語言，交織出令人驚嘆的文化融合。從商業巨埠拉哥斯（Lagos）充滿活力的數位新創生態圈，到全球產量名列前茅的「諾萊塢（Nollywood）」電影工業與席捲歐美的 Afrobeats 流行音樂，奈及利亞已成為整個非洲大陸向世界輸出流行文化的最核心引擎。

list: Diverse landscape ranging from coastal mangrove forests to high plateaus
Southern coastal plain covered in lush swamps and tropical rain forests
Dry northern grasslands border the semi-arid African Sahel belt
The Niger River basin supports extensive farming and high demographics
en.text:
Covering approximately 923,768 square kilometers, Nigeria's geography is highly varied. The southern coast is defined by extensive delta creeks, mangrove swamps, and rain forests, which transition to the central savanna and the dry Sahel plains of the north.

The mighty Niger River and its tributary, the Benue, are the vital waterways that support agricultural production and trade routes throughout the country.

list: 地形多樣，從海岸到高原皆有
南部為熱帶沿海地區
北部較乾燥接近薩赫勒地帶
尼日河流域為重要農業區
zh.text: 奈及利亞國土面積約 923,768 平方公里，地理景觀呈現明顯的南北差異。南部沿海地區佈滿了交錯的三角洲溪流、紅樹林沼澤與繁茂的熱帶雨林；向內陸延伸則逐漸轉變為中部的稀樹草原，直至最北部緊鄰非洲撒哈拉沙漠半乾旱薩赫勒地帶的乾燥荒原。雄偉的尼日河（Niger River）及其最大支流貝努埃河（Benue River）縱貫全國，構成了支撐全境大規模農業灌溉與商業貿易物流的核心命脈水系。

list: Predominantly tropical climate with distinct rainy and dry cycles
Southern delta zones remain hot, humid, and rain-swept year-round
Northern high plains experience dry, intensely hot conditions
Rainy periods generally occur from April through October each year
en.text:
Nigeria has a tropical climate governed by the movement of the Intertropical Convergence Zone. The south is hot and humid year-round with high rainfall, while the north is dry and hot with a short rainy season.

The country experiences a dry harmattan wind from the Sahara during the winter months, and the north faces ongoing risks of desertification and periodic droughts.

list: 熱帶氣候為主
南部高溫潮濕
北部較乾燥炎熱
雨季與旱季分明
zh.text: 奈及利亞整體屬於受間熱帶輻合帶控制的熱帶氣候。南部沿海與三角洲地帶全年高溫潮濕、降雨豐沛，呈現熱帶雨林氣候；而北方高原與平原則炎熱乾燥，雨季非常短暫。在冬季月份，全國會受到來自撒哈拉沙漠乾燥且夾帶沙塵的哈麥丹風（Harmattan）影響，這使得北部區域長年面臨土地沙漠化擴張以及週期性季節乾旱的生態挑戰，農業活動高度依賴每年 4 月至 10 月的降雨規律。

list: Rapidly growing population exceeding 220 million residents
Holds the largest national population on the African continent
Highly diverse demographic mosaic with over 250 distinct ethnic groups
Remarkably young population structure driving labor and consumption
en.text:
With a population of over 220 million, Nigeria is the most populous nation in Africa. It is a highly diverse federation dominated by three major ethnic groups: the Hausa-Fulani in the north, the Yoruba in the southwest, and the Igbo in the southeast.

The official language is English, but more than 500 indigenous languages are spoken. The exceptionally young population drives rapid urban growth and dynamic digital adaptation.

list: 人口超過 2.2億
非洲人口第一大國
民族與語言極度多元
年輕人口比例極高
zh.text: 奈及利亞總人口已突破 2.2 億人，是非洲人口最多且全球人口密度相當高的聯邦國家。依據官方最新族群統計，奈及利亞主要由三大核心民族主導：**豪薩-富拉尼族（Hausa-Fulani）主要分布於北方，約 6,600 萬人（佔 30%）**；**約魯巴族（Yoruba）主要分布於西南部，約 4,620 萬人（佔 21%）**；**伊博族（Igbo）則集中於東南部，約 3,960 萬人（佔 18%）**。其餘 31% 人口則由兩百多個少數族群構成。官方語言為英語，但全境實際使用的本土語言高達 500 多種。奈及利亞的人口結構極其年輕，龐大的青年勞動力與消費人口正以驚人的速度推動主要城市的擴張以及行動數位科技的迅速普及。

list: A leading economy in Africa driven by services and resource sectors
Vast exporter of crude oil, dominate national export earnings
Lagos has emerged as the premier tech startup hub and financial core
Addressing economic diversification and uneven income structures
en.text:
Nigeria has one of the largest economies in Africa, traditionally dependent on crude oil exports, which generate the majority of government revenue. 

In recent years, the country has successfully diversified, with Lagos becoming the premier financial capital and tech hub of West Africa (often called the 'Silicon Valley of Africa') alongside rapid growth in retail, telecommunications, and financial services.

list: 非洲最大經濟體之一
石油出口占重要地位
金融與科技產業快速發展
經濟結構不均衡
zh.text: 奈及利亞是非洲最大的經濟體之一，長期以來高度依賴原油出口，石油與天然氣產業為國家貢獻了絕大部分的外匯收入與財政資源。然而，近年來奈及利亞已展開多元化轉型，最大都市拉哥斯（Lagos）迅速蛻變為西非首屈一指的金融首都與跨國新創科技重鎮（常被國際譽為「非洲矽谷」），連帶拉動了電子商務、行動金融支付、電信網通以及零售服務業的爆發式成長，目前政府正致力於進一步優化電網基礎建設與縮減貧富差距。

list: Federal presidential republic structured with 36 constituent states
Federal President acts as the head of state and chief executive
Democratic systems have operated continuously since reforms in 1999
Regional representation is carefully balanced across multi-ethnic states
en.text:
Nigeria is a federal presidential republic. The executive President is elected by popular vote to serve a four-year term. 

Since returning to democratic rule in 1999, the political system has maintained stability, though elections require complex regional alliances and careful power-sharing agreements between the Christian south and Muslim north.

list: 聯邦共和國
由36個州組成
民主制度運作中
區域與族群政治影響深遠
zh.text: 奈及利亞是一個由 36 個 constituent 邦州與一個聯邦首都特區組成的聯邦總統制共和國。經全民普選產生的聯邦總統兼任國家元首與最高行政首腦，任期四年。自 1999 年結束軍政府統治、全面回歸民主憲政體制以來，該國政治運作保持了長期穩定。由於國內民族與宗教結構盤根錯節，政黨大選與政策推行通常高度仰賴跨區域的政治結盟，以及在基督教徒為主的南方各州與穆斯林為主的北方各州之間尋求精確的地緣權力平衡。

list: Rapid urbanization driving the expansion of Lagos and Abuja
Substantial wealth gaps between major tech centers and rural areas
Strengthening municipal grids and public transit networks
Vibrant youth culture expressing innovation, music, and design
en.text:
Nigerian society is characterized by rapid urbanization and a highly energetic youth population. Major cities like Lagos face challenges in infrastructure, electricity supply, and municipal services.

Despite these challenges, the younger generation shows remarkable resilience, driving innovation in digital finance, fashion, and local business.

list: 貧富差距明顯
都市化快速進行
基礎設施仍待改善
青年文化活躍
zh.text: 奈及利亞當代社會的核心特徵在於狂飆式的都市化進程以及充滿幹勁的青年浪潮。諸如拉哥斯等巨型城市正面臨人口激增帶來的市政基礎設施過載、電力供應不穩與大眾運輸不足等成長痛點，這導致現代化科技金融核心區與鄉村地帶之間存在顯著的財政差距。儘管如此，具備高數位適應力的年輕世代展現出極強的韌性與創造力，積極在金融科技（FinTech）、前衛時尚設計與微型創業上引領全非潮流。

list: The premier hub of contemporary African pop and media culture
Vibrant film sector 'Nollywood' produces immense movie volumes
Afrobeats music genre enjoys massive global streaming success
Strong influence of traditional ethnic customs and vibrant attire
en.text:
Nigeria is a global cultural powerhouse. Its film industry, Nollywood, is one of the largest in the world by volume, producing thousands of films annually. 

In music, the rise of the Afrobeats genre, featuring stars like Burna Boy and Wizkid, has captured global charts, while traditional arts and colorful native attire remain central to daily life.

list: 非洲流行文化中心之一
音樂與電影產業發達
宗教影響力強
傳統文化多元並存
zh.text: 奈及利亞是舉世公認的全球黑人流行文化巨擘。其本土電影工業「諾萊塢（Nollywood）」以驚人的數位產值與製作規模高居全球第二大電影市場，每年發行數千部深受全非及海外非裔社群熱愛的影視作品。在音樂領域，源自奈及利亞的 Afrobeats 音樂風格在 Burna Boy、Wizkid 等國際巨星引領下，近年橫掃全球各大音樂串流榜單。與此同時，多元的傳統部落藝術、傳統編織與色彩斑斕的民族盛裝（如 Agbada）依然深深融入並點綴著人們的日常生活。

list: Combatting regional security threats and militant groups
Managing massive urban migration and youth unemployment
Mitigating delta oil pollution and ecological degradation
Expanding public grid capacity and reliable electricity supply
en.text:
Nigeria faces security challenges, particularly from militant groups in the northeast. The Niger Delta also struggles with environmental pollution caused by historical oil spills.

Economic reforms are focused on expanding the national electricity grid, reducing poverty, and creating jobs for the rapidly growing youth population.

list: 貧困與失業問題
治安與犯罪問題
石油污染與環境問題
人口快速成長壓力
zh.text: 奈及利亞目前正面臨多重棘手的結構性挑戰。在安全地緣政治上，東北部邊境長期受到極端武裝組織的區域安全威脅；而在南方的尼日河三角洲地區，數十年來因原油開採與管道洩漏所累積的環境污染，已對當地的生態保育與傳統漁農業造成深遠破壞。當前的經濟體制改革，正聚焦於加速擴建中央與地方電網容量以解決長期缺電問題、降低青年失業率，並在人口暴增的壓力下有效緩解結構性貧窮。

list: Abuja — Modern planned federal capital centered around Aso Rock
Lagos — Gigantic commercial metropolis built across lagoons and islands
Kano — Ancient commercial gateway and historic clay-walled city
Zuma Rock — Massive monolithic granite peak standing guard near Abuja
en.text:
Lagos is West Africa's most populous and economically dynamic city, featuring the busy business districts of Victoria Island and Lekki. Abuja, the planned federal capital, is known for its spacious roads and the grand Zuma Rock monolith.

Kano in the north preserves centuries of historic market trade and ancient clay walls.

list: 阿布加（Abuja）——首都與行政中心
拉哥斯（Lagos）——最大城市與金融中心
卡諾（Kano）——北部重要商業城市
蘇瑪岩（Zuma Rock）——知名自然地標
zh.text: 巨型港市拉哥斯（Lagos）是西非人口最稠密、經濟最蓬勃的超級大都會，坐擁維多利亞島（Victoria Island）與萊基（Lekki）等摩天大樓林立的中央商務區；聯邦首都阿布加（Abuja）則是一座經過精心規劃的現代化行政中心，以寬敞發達的公路網與高聳入雲的巨石地標阿索岩（Aso Rock）著稱；位於北方的古老門戶卡諾（Kano）則完好保留了數百年的跨撒哈拉黏土古城牆與繁華的傳統手工藝世紀市集；而首都近郊那座高達 725 公尺的單體花崗岩「蘇瑪岩（Zuma Rock）」，更以其形似人臉的自然紋理成為國家精神的守護象徵。

list: Dominant political and economic leader within West Africa
Pivotal leading member of the African Union (AU) body
Key founding member of the West African ECOWAS alliance
Highly active in global oil policies and regional peace initiatives
en.text:
Nigeria is a major geopolitical power in Africa, serving as a founding pillar of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) and the African Union.

As a prominent OPEC member, it holds significant influence in global oil markets and actively contributes military forces to regional peacekeeping missions.

list: 西非區域強國
非洲聯盟重要成員
石油出口影響力大
積極參與區域維和
zh.text: 奈及利亞是非洲大陸無可爭議的地緣政治強權與外交領袖，同時也是西非國家經濟共同體（ECOWAS）以及非洲聯盟（AU）最重要的創始與財政支柱之一。作為石油輸出國組織（OPEC）的核心成員，奈及利亞對全球原油價格與市場供應鏈發揮著舉足輕重的戰略影響力，並長期向聯合國及西非地區派遣大規模維和部隊以維護區域和平穩定。

list: Trade relations focused on electronics, auto parts, and petrochemicals
Active commercial offices located in Lagos and Taipei
Potential for cooperation in digital fintech and agricultural technology
Bilateral business forums promoting import-export exchange
en.text:
Taiwan and Nigeria maintain non-official trade relations. Nigeria exports crude oil, liquefied natural gas, and agricultural goods to Taiwan, which in turn exports machinery, auto parts, and electronics.

Trade and cultural exchanges are supported by trade offices in Lagos and Taipei, with growing business interest in digital finance, agricultural machinery, and plastics.

list: 經貿往來有限
能源與市場合作潛力存在
教育與商業交流逐步增加
非官方互動為主
zh.text: 奈及利亞與台灣之間維持著長期且穩健的非官方實質經貿夥伴關係，雙方分別於台北（Taipei）與拉哥斯（Lagos）互設具備領務與商務功能之代表機構。奈及利亞是台灣在西非地區最重要的戰略能源與農產進口來源之一，台灣長年向其採購高品質原油、液化天然氣（LNG）及高品質芝麻等經濟作物；而台灣則向奈及利亞廣大市場出口精密工業工具機、汽車零組件、塑膠加工設備與半導體電子產品。近年來，隨著兩國雙邊經貿論壇的定期召開，雙方在數位金融科技（FinTech）對接、現代化農業機械化改進以及跨國人才教育交流等新興領域，皆展現出極具前景的實質合作潛力。

list: The most populous country in Africa and sixth globally
Home to Nollywood, the world's second-largest movie industry
Holds massive reserves of high-quality crude oil and natural gas
Regarded as one of the most dynamic future consumer markets in Africa
非洲人口最多國家
擁有世界級音樂與電影產業
石油資源豐富
被視為非洲未來最大市場之一

value.zh: 英語（官方）、豪薩語、約魯巴語、伊博語

text.en: The Green-White flag — Three vertical stripes representing the fertile green agriculture and the white peace of unified Nigeria
text.zh: 雙綠夾白國旗——兩側垂直的綠色條紋象徵奈及利亞肥沃茂盛的農業資源與茂密森林，中間的白色條紋代表和平、純潔與聯邦的統一

text.en: Nollywood Cinema — The world's second-largest film industry by volume, producing thousands of popular home videos and movies annually
text.zh: 非洲好萊塢「諾萊塢」——產量高居全球第二的巨大電影工業「Nollywood」，每年產出數千部極具創意的本土電影與肥皂劇，風靡全非與黑人社群

text.en: Afrobeats Rhythms — The global musical revolution originating in Lagos, commanding international streaming and pop charts
text.zh: 風靡全球的 Afrobeats 流行樂——源自拉哥斯街頭、融合西非傳統打擊樂與現代嘻哈的革命性音樂風格，近年橫掃全球音樂榜單，引領黑人流行文化

text.en: Monolithic Zuma Rock — The legendary 725-meter natural granite peak, standing as the gatekeeper near Abuja
text.zh: 守護巨石 Zuma Rock——座落於首都阿布加北方、高達725公尺的巨大單體花崗岩巨石，是國家精神的象徵，其側面岩紋酷似人臉，充滿神秘傳說

text.en: African Oil Powerhouse — Dominating West African oil production, holding rich subterranean fields of crude oil and natural gas
text.zh: 非洲第一大產油國——奈及利亞擁有幾內亞灣豐富的優質輕質原油與天然氣儲量，是石油輸出國組織（OPEC）重要成員，主導國家財政與外匯
